Team,

Run of show for Sunday Oct 25 album CD release celebration attached. Setup 9:30 AM in the fellowship hall (Deacon Harris + banquet team). Album table + Stripe iPad live from 12:30 PM. Amanda's remarks at 12:45.

Amanda

Marlene,

Confirming: Track 2 'Vessels of the King' is in D major. Your solo entrance is at bar 34. Rehearsal Thursday 7 PM - we'll run it three times so you can find your pocket.

Grace and peace,
Amanda

Team,

Quick note: Thursday rehearsal is 7 PM sharp in the sanctuary. Please pull sheet music for Track 4 and 'How Great Thou Art'. See you then.

Grace and peace,
Amanda

Derek,

Just listened to the Track 4 mix - the choir entrance at 2:14 lands beautifully. One note: could we bring Marcus Reed's lead vocal up 1.5 dB in the bridge? Otherwise ready for mastering.

Amanda

Deacon Harris,

Attached is the current convention fundraising tally - $19,500 raised against the $28,000 goal, $8,500 gap. Banh mi sale delivers this weekend and the concert is in three weeks. Should close cleanly.

Amanda

Section leaders,

Sunday setlist for the 11 AM contemporary service:
1. Way Maker (opener)
2. Goodness of God
3. Anthem: Total Praise
4. Sermon response: Great Are You Lord

Janet, please confirm your soprano intro on Total Praise.

Grace and peace,
Amanda

Angela,

Youth choir call time this Saturday is 1 PM sharp. Please have the theory quiz ready for the parents to sign off. Emmanuel will be there - Terrence has him warmed up.

Amanda

Sister Wilson,

Thank you for the generous $2,500 pledge to the convention fund. It moves us to $22,000 raised - we can nearly taste Dallas from here. Your gift is being logged today.

With so much gratitude,
Amanda Tran
Music Director, GAW Center

Robert,

Hoping to book the Steinway tuning for the week of Oct 12 - before the album release Sunday. Tuesday Oct 13 at 10 AM if the sanctuary is clear works best. Please confirm.

Amanda

Kevin,

Final headcount for the Aug 4 charter is 50 (45 choir + 5 musicians). Please confirm the 55-seat coach is available and that the second driver is booked for the Little Rock overnight leg. Payment ready to release.

Amanda
